design.md:
# Generated baseline (the studio made this; improve it)

Template: **obby**. The kit runs the whole core loop; game.json and the world spec configure it. Write code only for what the template does not do (as systems with specs), never a second copy of the loop or the HUD.

Course: 30 stages over a lava basin, themes lava → forest → meadow → candy → ice; one new obstacle at a time, a checkpoint every stage, the finish pays 250.

Tutorial quests: Reach stage 3 → Reach stage 10 → Reach stage 20 → Finish the obby!.

World: Generated 1050 objects (about 1729 parts).
  - Art style: stylized.
  - Course: 30 stages, 10 kinds of obstacle, climbing to y 233.
  Models by role: conifer 900001
  
Brief must-haves to check against: Three stages with checkpoints; A lava floor that resets players; A finish with a reward
